title: ElationNoteUpdate
description:
Request body for updating a sections-based note.

When ``content_map`` is sent on a base note update, ``snapshot_id`` is required
(from create or GET /notes/{id}/edit) for collaborative conflict detection.

Field order: content-update fields (`content_map`, `snapshot_id`) first, then
mutable fields in the same order as ``ElationNoteCreate`` (``provider`` through
``metadata``; create-only ``layout_name``, ``practice``, ``patient`` omitted),
then ``confidential``.

bill.description: The ID of the bill associated with the note.
bill.title: Bill

category.description: Practice-created identifier for note category (Visit Note Type).
category.title: Category

provider.description: The ID of the assigned provider.
provider.title: Provider

AttrsWithRefId.description: Base attrs for any node that carries a stable change-tracking ref_id.
AttrsWithRefId.title: AttrsWithRefId

ContentMap-Input.description:
Typed map from section type to its content. All sections are optional.

Keys match section ``type`` wire values (``NodeType``): lowercase single words
(e.g. ``narrative``, ``vitals``) or camelCase for multi-word nodes (e.g. ``followUp``).
ContentMap-Input.title: ContentMap

content.description: List-item children, capped at two: a single child must be a paragraph, and a second child (if present) must be a nested ordered or unordered list. Shape is [paragraph] or [paragraph, nested list].
content.title: Content

HandoutTypeName.description: Handout kind. Hippo reconciles this into its integer ``type`` if needed.
HandoutTypeName.title: HandoutTypeName

content.description: List-item children, capped at two: a single child must be a paragraph, and a second child (if present) must be a nested ordered or unordered list. Shape is [paragraph] or [paragraph, nested list].
content.title: Content

LineBreakInline.description: Hard line break. No attrs, no content.
LineBreakInline.title: LineBreakInline

content.description: List-item children, capped at two: a single child must be a paragraph, and a second child (if present) must be a nested ordered or unordered list. Shape is [paragraph] or [paragraph, nested list].
content.title: Content

content.description: List-item children, capped at two: a single child must be a paragraph, and a second child (if present) must be a nested ordered or unordered list. Shape is [paragraph] or [paragraph, nested list].
content.title: Content

ReferencedDocumentData.description:
Structured reference to a hippo document (e.g. a lab/imaging report).

Mirrors the VN1 reference-bullet payload: ``id`` is the report/document id,
``lab_result_id`` identifies an individual lab result within a lab report,
``summary`` is the link text shown in the UI, and ``summary_formatting``
carries optional VN1-style decoration offsets (kept for backport parity).
ReferencedDocumentData.title: ReferencedDocumentData

TextInline-Input.description:
Plain text run.

This node has NO ``attrs``: both ``text`` and ``marks`` are top-level keys.
This is the one deliberate exception to the type/attrs/content rule
documented at the top of this module — it mirrors the VN2 TextNode wire
shape verbatim (and ProseMirror's text node, where ``text`` and ``marks``
sit beside ``type`` with no ``attrs``), keeping the two schema-compatible.
TextInline-Input.title: TextInline

TextInlineMark.description: A single formatting mark applied to a TextInline run.
TextInlineMark.title: TextInlineMark

VitalsSection-Input.description: Tier-1 vitals section; attrs mirror VN2 ``VitalsNode``.
VitalsSection-Input.title: VitalsSection

el8_note_models__note__sections__shared_.description:
Formatting marks a text run can carry.

Supports ``bold``, ``italic``, ``strike`` (strikethrough), and ``underline``.
el8_note_models__note__sections__shared_.title: TextBlockMarkTypes
